cases.exposure_context_quote: Case 1 was a 76-year-old man who intermittently immersed his perineum in diluted paraquat solution for 3 consecutive days because of eczema of the perineal skin.
cases.agent_quote: The patient had soaked his scrotum in diluted paraquat solution 5 days before the hospital visit.
cases.circumstance: non-occupational self-treatment: repeatedly soaked scrotum in diluted paraquat solution to treat eczema, 3-4 times a day for 10-20 minutes over several days

symptoms.finding: pain, swelling and erosion of scrotum
symptoms.quote: he discovered severe damage to his scrotal skin and experienced pain, swelling, and erosion of the scrotum
A day before the visit, he developed mild chest tightness and visited another local hospital, where scrotal cleaning and rehydration were performed.
Wet rales were heard in both lungs.
He developed severe kidney and lung damage after admission and died on Day 6 of admission.

In the afternoon, the patient complained of chest tightness and increased chest pain, and his blood oxygen saturation level decreased to 70%. Chest computed tomography showed diffused infiltration with bilateral lung distribution.

cases.time_to_care: visited another local hospital 1 day before referral; transferred to the study hospital ~2 days after cessation of skin exposure (5 days after starting soaking)

labs.name: arterial blood gas (day 4)
labs.value: pH 7.23; PaCO2 28 mmHg; PaO2 42 mmHg; Lac 4.6 mmol/L; K+ 3.35 mmol/L
labs.quote: Arterial blood gas analysis results were as follows: pH, 7.23; PaCO2, 28 mmHg; PaO2, 42 mmHg; Lac, 4.6 mmol/L; and K+, 3.35 mmol/L.

treatment.name: scrotal cleaning and rehydration (local hospital)
treatment.quote: he developed mild chest tightness and visited another local hospital, where scrotal cleaning and rehydration were performed.

treatment.name: dexamethasone 40 mg once daily
treatment.quote: Initial treatment mainly included dexamethasone (40 mg, once a day)

treatment.name: reduced glutathione 2.4 g once daily
treatment.quote: reduced glutathione (2.4 g, once a day)

treatment.name: alanyl-glutamine 10 g/50 mL once daily
treatment.quote: alanyl-glutamine (10 g/50 mL, once a day)

treatment.name: topical kangfuxin solution to scrotal skin
treatment.quote: A kangfuxin solution (Chinese Medicine Approval: Z53020054, Kunming Sino Pharmaceutical Co. Ltd., Kunmin, China) was applied externally to the patient’s scrotal skin.

treatment.name: oxygen via mask 5 L/minute
treatment.quote: Oxygen was administered through a mask at 5 L/minute.

cases.outcome: died on Day 6 of admission of cardiac arrest
cases.outcome_quote: On Day 6 of admission, the patient died of cardiac arrest.
cases.notes: Endotracheal intubation and ventilator refused by family; discussion also mentions repeated blood perfusion and high-dose hormonal shock treatment. Urine sodium bicarbonate/sodium bisulfite test turned mild blue.

cases.exposure_context_quote: A 23-year-old pregnant woman with psychosis ingested approximately 100 mL of paraquat (W/V, 20%) during gestational week 36.
cases.agent_quote: ingested approximately 100 mL of paraquat (W/V, 20%) during gestational week 36
cases.circumstance: ingestion during pregnancy (gestational week 36); patient had psychosis; intent not explicitly stated

symptoms.quote: On Day 3, the patient experienced mild chest congestion.
Eighty-one hours after ingestion, the patient’s dyspnea worsened.

symptoms.finding: throat and abdominal pain and regular contractions
symptoms.quote: She experienced throat and abdominal pain and regular contractions.
laboratory results showed Cr of 222 μmol/L and BUN of 15.3 mmol/L

cases.time_to_care: gastric lavage performed and transferred 6 hours after exposure

labs.name: blood paraquat concentration (initial)
labs.quote: her blood paraquat concentration was 0.81 μg/mL.

labs.name: WBC
labs.quote: The patient’s laboratory test results were as follows: WBC, 7.56 × 109/L; NEU%, 83.6%; hemoglobin, 102 g/L; D-dimer, 4.38 μg/mL; and potassium, 3.41 mmol/L.

labs.name: urine dithionate test
labs.quote: The patient’s urine turned blue when tested with dithionate (Figure 2)

labs.name: post-delivery labs
labs.value: WBC 8.99 × 10^9/L; hemoglobin 105 g/L; D-dimer 5.67 μg/mL; Cr 272 μmol/L; BUN 17.9 mmol/L; ALT 107 IU/L; AST 121 IU/L; CK-MB 1.7 ng/mL; hs-CTNI 13.5 ng/L; amylase 179 IU/L; lipase 92 IU/L
labs.quote: The mother’s laboratory test results after delivery were as follows: WBC, 8.99 × 109/L; hemoglobin, 105 g/L; D-dimer, 5.67 μg/mL; Cr, 272 μmol/L; BUN, 17.9 mmol/L; ALT, 107 IU/L; AST, 121 IU/L; CK-MB, 1.7 ng/mL (normal value: 0.3–4.0 ng/mL); hs-CTNI, 13.5 ng/L (normal value: 0–17.4 ng/L); amylase, 179 IU/L; and lipase, 92 IU/L.

treatment.name: gastric lavage
treatment.quote: Gastric lavage was performed and the patient was transferred to our department for further treatment 6 hours after exposure.

treatment.name: activated carbon (Smecta) and mannitol orally for gastrointestinal decontamination
treatment.quote: She received activated carbon (Smecta®) and mannitol by oral administration for gastrointestinal decontamination.

treatment.name: dexamethasone 40 mg once daily
treatment.quote: Other treatments included dexamethasone (40 mg, once a day)

treatment.name: reduced glutathione 1.8 g once daily
treatment.quote: reduced glutathione (1.8 g, once a day)

cases.outcome: mother died of refractory respiratory failure 2 days after delivery; baby died within hours of birth
cases.outcome_quote: The baby died after a few hours, and the mother died of refractory respiratory failure 2 days after delivery.
cases.notes: Refused hemoperfusion and cesarean section; vaginally birthed a baby girl 83 hours after ingestion (birth weight 2250 g, Apgar 5 at 5 min, CPR performed). Paraquat concentrations: maternal blood 0.19, fetal blood 0.23, umbilical cord blood 0.20, amniotic fluid 0.47 μg/mL.
